answer: A bonded attestation graph: each agent stakes and links to peers; rewards use a concave function of cluster stake, so splitting a timber stake across sybils cannot raise total payout. Attestations cost fees and bonds; false edges are slashed. Cluster detection flags a grove of mutually attesting agents via low graph conductance, with each identity a vertex. Attacker pays bonds, fees, and slashing risk; limitations include collusion, rich attackers, and false positives.
